positions.title: Application Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of a proof of concept iOS app demonstrating ReplayKit and WebRTC compatibility.
• Improved continuous delivery efforts by automating iOS project build in Jenkins.
• Designed, automated, and maintained all unit test projects using NUnit, .NET Core, and Jenkins.
• Built cross-platform mock library for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android projects using LightMock.
• Implemented bug fixes as part of an Agile Scrum team in collaboration with other departments.
• Created and tested internal release builds and accompanying documentation.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Administered and maintained more than 50 on-site computers and printers.
• Coordinated the acquisition of a new multifunction copier from a vendor.
• Created utility applications and Microsoft Office add-ins using Java and C#.
• Engaged in testing prototype Zigbee wireless lighting systems.
